confidence_notes: Medium overall. Food and drink anchors come from web search snippets with Cagliari-specific aggregator figures (Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, HikersBay) plus Sardinian and Italy-wide guides. The sources conflict, some are undated, and most figures are late-2026 page snapshots rather than July 2026 observations. Cocktail and wine rest on looser guide ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge only; no booking pages or listings were checked and no accommodation searches were run. EUR-to-USD conversion uses an approximate 1.08 rate from a secondary early-2026 snippet rather than a current rate, so USD values carry roughly 5 percent FX uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink: Cagliari-specific aggregator and venue figures, cross-checked against Italy-wide price guides. Accommodation: holistic benchmark of typical July rates in Sardinian and mid-sized southern Italian coastal cities, from general knowledge only.
